name: Tandem
description: Your own affiliate program: people who like your site sign up, get their link and earn a commission on the sales, bookings or contacts they bring. Approval by hand or at once, an affiliate area in the account, commissions in percent or fixed with a refund window, payouts by hand with CSV export, emails in Italian and English. Links tracked only with consent. Free: unlimited affiliates, one source (Cleishop, Agenda, Store or Forms).
author: Cleitext
